title: k-wise uniformity testing

problem.name: k-wise uniformity testing
problem.statement_latex: Given purified access to a distribution $p$ on $\{0,1\}^n$, test whether every marginal on at most $k$ coordinates is uniform, versus being $\varepsilon$-far in total variation from all such distributions. Here $k$ is fixed.
problem.statement_text: Given purified access to a distribution $p$ on $\{0,1\}^n$, test whether every marginal on at most $k$ coordinates is uniform, versus being $\varepsilon$-far in total variation from all such distributions. Here $k$ is fixed.
